items.title: Terry McLaurin: Heads to IR
items.text:
The Commanders placed McLaurin (knee) on injured reserve Wednesday, Zach Selby of the team's official site reports.

items.title: Braelon Allen: Managing ankle injury in Week 8
items.text:
Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Allen will be a limited participant in Wednesday's practice due to ankle injury, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

items.title: Breece Hall: Beginning week with limited practice
items.text:
Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Hall (quadriceps) will be limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

items.title: Emeka Egbuka: Practicing in non-contact jersey
items.text:
Egbuka (concussion/foot) was on the field for the start of Wednesday's practice and was donning a non-contact jersey, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

items.title: Jaylen Waddle: Uncertain to play Sunday
items.text:
Waddle aggravated a previous chest injury during last week's 30-16 win over the Cardinals, and his status for Sunday's game against the Chiefs will be determined based on how he fares in practice this week, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
